chunks: 3511 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from some of them, peace be upon them, who said:
Ali, peace be upon him, when a man died and had a wife who was a slave, would purchase her from his estate, emancipate her, and then make her an heir.

key_terms.مَالِهِ: his estate or property left behind

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام rule regarding a slave-wife when her husband died?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal practice attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام regarding a deceased man's slave-wife. She would be purchased from the deceased's estate, freed, and then included among the heirs, reflecting a ruling related to emancipation and inheritance.
